Health Ministry Launches Webinar Series on State Health Initiatives

India's Union Health Ministry has initiated a monthly webinar series focused on discussing and promoting good health initiatives undertaken by various states. The program aims to share innovative public health practices across the country. This initiative is part of the National Health Mission (NHM).
